Hi Luis,

Thanks for coming back to us, and for choosing.

Option 3 it is: the $200 difference goes back to the payment method you used on order Shop····. A colleague is picking that up today, and you will get a confirmation here as soon as it is issued. Once it leaves our side, cards and PayPal usually take a few business days to show it.

Nothing else changes on your order. The Harlo H15 Dual, with the Harlo OS Diagnostics add-on in the same box, stays allocated to you and ships November 30 to (address hidden).

Sorry again for the longer wait on this one, and thanks for your patience.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I've passed this to the team so they can confirm the details with you directly, and they will follow up shortly.

INSTRUCTION FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Georges typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: Georges approved a refund of $200.00 on Shop····, money only. Run the order-swap skill: approved_refund.py check --email <the order's email> --order Shop····, then approved_refund.py refund --email <same> --order Shop···· --confirmed --amount 200.00. Only when it reports refunded: true, tell the customer it is done, the amount, and that it goes back to their original payment method, usually 3 to 5 business days to show. If it refuses or reports problems, do not say it is done: flag it and tell the customer the team will confirm the refund shortly.
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.

Hi Luis,

That is done. We have refunded $200.00 to your original payment method, the PayPal account you paid with. PayPal usually shows it within 3 to 5 business days, depending on your bank.

Nothing else on the order changes. Your Harlo H15 Dual, with the Harlo OS Diagnostics add-on going out in the same box, stays yours and ships November 30 to (address hidden). You will get tracking by email as soon as the label is printed.

Thanks for your patience on this one, Luis.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
